slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“记住爷爷的话。爷爷死后，不管发生什么，都要留在这里。”
“三年，只要三年。”
“三年后，进云雾山，找黑熊峰。”
“爷爷……为你改命了……”
冷风裹挟着白雾，从茫茫无际的云雾山里涌进村子。卷过黄泥小路，漫过简陋的屋顶，丝丝缕缕的泻进门缝里。
土屋里湿冷空荡，没有桌凳，没有衣柜，也没有炭盆，只有角落里一张用几块木板拼凑的床铺，破旧的露出棉絮的被子下，一个皮肤蜡黄，身形枯瘦的少年，正蜷缩在里面瑟瑟发抖。
周元睡不着。
太冷了。
他怕睡着了，再也醒不来了。
也是心里兴奋，因为明天就是‘三年之约’了。
周元不知道爷爷那句‘改命’是什么意思，爷爷当时说完就咽气了。
不过，想起爷爷的经历，他相信那应该不只是临死前的呓语。
想当初，爷爷也只是村里普通的猎户，十次进山七次空手，三天饿九顿是常态，活的很难很难。周元父母都是活活饿死的。
突然有一年冬天，爷爷不一样了。
每次进山，都会有收获。
刚开始是捡到撞树的兔子、冻僵的蛇，后来还能套到成群野鸡、抓到缺氧的鱼，猎到肥硕的袍子、受伤的独狼。
再往后更夸张，爷爷甚至能挖到罕见的灵植宝药。
从那之后，爷爷富有起来，盖起了村子里人人羡慕的瓦房。
那段日子，也是周元最幸福的日子。
顿顿都是白面。

每天能吃两顿，还能吃到肉。
衣服都是换着穿。
提亲的能从村这头排到那头。
只是那段幸福的好日子并没有持续太久，短短两年半，爷爷的身体开始每况愈下，肉眼可见的衰老，吃什么药都无济于事。
直到那天，爷爷像是下定了某种决心。
“三年了……”
周元眼底泛起希冀的明光。
黑熊峰有什么？
是撞死的兔子？
还是成群的野鸡？
是珍贵的人参？
还是神秘的灵植？
他会不会也如爷爷那般，时来运转，每次进山，都能有收获？
“嘭……”
破烂的房门被猛地踹开，门板撞到土墙，发出吱呀的哀嚎。
一个穿着厚实棉衣的胖大男人，裹挟着寒风白雾，闯进了这间土坯房，眼睛适应了屋里的昏暗后，仔细看着板床上一动不动的周元，粗声粗气的喊了句：“死了吗？”
周元看着一脸凶相的胖男人，被子里的双手用力握紧。这是村里的恶霸宋奎，以前游手好闲，无恶不作。偷鸡抢粮，翻寡妇墙。甚至还挖过坟。在得知爷爷死后，第一时间闯进灵堂，非说爷爷认了他当干儿子，强行霸占了新盖的大瓦房。
再后来，宋奎娶了村里的齐寡妇，把周元赶到了旁边的这间土屋。
“草，还活着啊！”
宋奎看周元眼珠还在转，顿时撇了撇嘴。

这小子命是真硬啊，三天一顿猪食都饿不死，这破屋子又潮又冷，就一张破棉被也没冻死。
“妈的，几点了还在睡，赶紧起来，进山打猎。今天还抓不到野鸡，别想吃饭。”
content_en:
"Remember what grandpa said. After grandpa dies, no matter what happens, he must stay here."
"Three years, only three years."
"Three years later, enter Yunwu Mountain and look for Black Bear Peak."
"Grandpa... changed your life for you..."
The cold wind carries the white mist and pours into the village from the boundless mountains of cloud and mist. It rolled through the yellow mud path, spread over the simple roofs, and trickled into the cracks of the door.
The earthen house was damp, cold and empty. There were no tables, stools, wardrobes or charcoal basins. There was only a bed in the corner made of several wooden boards. Under the shabby quilt with exposed cotton wool, a young boy with sallow skin and a thin body was curled up and shivering inside.
Zhou Yuan couldn't sleep.
It's too cold.
He was afraid that he would fall asleep and never wake up again.
I’m also excited because tomorrow is the ‘three-year appointment’.
Zhou Yuan didn’t know what grandpa meant by ‘change your life’. Grandpa died right after he finished speaking.
However, thinking of his grandfather's experience, he believed that it was not just a rant before his death.
I think back then, my grandfather was just an ordinary hunter in the village. He went into the mountains seven times out of ten times empty-handed. It was normal to go hungry for nine meals in three days. Life was very difficult. Zhou Yuan's parents both starved to death.
Suddenly one winter, Grandpa was different.
Every time you go into the mountains, you will gain something.
At first, I picked up rabbits that hit trees and frozen snakes. Later, I was able to lasso groups of pheasants, catch fish that lacked oxygen, hunt fat robes, and injured lone wolves.
Even more exaggerated later, grandpa can even dig up rare spiritual plant treasures.
From then on, grandpa became rich and built a tile-roofed house that everyone in the village envied.
Those days were also Zhou Yuan's happiest days.
Every meal is white.
I can eat two meals a day, and I can still eat meat.
The clothes are always changed.
Those who propose marriage can line up from one end of the village to the other.
But those happy days didn't last long. In just two and a half years, my grandfather's health began to deteriorate. He was showing signs of aging, and no amount of medicine could help.
Until that day, Grandpa seemed to have made some kind of determination.
"Three years..."
Zhou Yuan's eyes were filled with hope.
What's in Black Bear Peak?
Was it a killed rabbit?
Or a flock of pheasants?
Is it the precious ginseng?
Or a mysterious spiritual plant?
Will he be like his grandfather, with fortunes turning and he will gain something every time he goes into the mountains?
"Bang..."
The broken door was kicked open violently, and the door panel hit the earthen wall, making a squeaking cry.
A fat man wearing a thick cotton coat broke into this adobe house in the cold wind and white mist. After his eyes adjusted to the dimness in the room, he looked carefully at Zhou Yuan who was motionless on the plank bed, and shouted in a rough voice: "Is he dead?"
Zhou Yuan looked at the fat man with a fierce look and clenched his hands tightly under the quilt. This is Song Kui, the village bully. He used to be idle and do all kinds of evil. Steal chickens, grab food, climb over the widow's wall. Even graves were dug. After learning that his grandfather had died, he immediately broke into the mourning hall, claiming that his grandfather recognized him as his godson and forcibly occupied the newly built large tile-roofed house.
Later, Song Kui married the widow Qi in the village and drove Zhou Yuan to the earthen house next to her.
"Grass, you're still alive!"
Seeing that Zhou Yuan's eyes were still rolling, Song Kui immediately curled his lips.
This kid's life is really tough. He couldn't starve to death even if he had a pig's meal for three days. This shabby house was damp and cold, and even a tattered quilt didn't freeze to death.
"Damn, what time is it? I'm still sleeping. Get up quickly and go hunting in the mountains. If you can't catch pheasants today, don't even think about eating."
